items.title: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS “Cinnamon Teal”
items.title_zh: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS「Cinnamon Teal」发布：新增客户端-服务器模式与触发器
items.title_en: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS "Cinnamon Teal" Adds Client-Server Mode and Triggers
items.summary: DuckDB releases 2.0.0 LTS 'Cinnamon Teal' with major scalability gains, client-server architecture, and Triggers support, drawing enthusiastic practitioner discussion on Hacker News.

items.title: PHP 8.2.35
items.title_zh: PHP 8.2.35 发布，修复严重的「PHP2Shell」远程代码执行漏洞
items.title_en: PHP 8.2.35 Released to Patch Critical 'PHP2Shell' RCE Vulnerabilities
items.summary: PHP 8.2.35 is a security release addressing a critical RCE ('PHP2Shell') disclosed in coordination with Wiz, Calif, and OpenAI, drawing heavy community scrutiny and reports of a possible second vulnerability.

items.title: 星舰超重型助推器首次在得克萨斯州的发射塔臂上成功着陆  接下来，星舰第二级将继续飞行，准备在印度洋受控溅落。
items.title_zh: 星舰超重型助推器首次在得克萨斯州的发射塔臂上成功着陆，接下来，星舰第二级将继续飞行，准备在印度洋受控溅落。
items.summary: SpaceX achieved the first successful landing/catch of Starship's Super Heavy booster on the Texas launch tower arms, while the second stage continued toward a controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean.

items.title: Railway Security Disclosure
items.title_zh: Railway 披露安全入侵事件，用户称密钥遭窃用
items.title_en: Railway Discloses Security Breach as Users Report Stolen Secrets
items.summary: Railway disclosed a security breach, and Hacker News commenters report that stored environment variables/secrets were decrypted and abused by third parties, framed alongside other major security events the same day.

items.title: GitLab Critical Patch Release
items.title_zh: GitLab 紧急发布关键正则编译器漏洞补丁
items.title_en: GitLab Ships Emergency Patch for Critical Regex Compiler Flaw
items.summary: GitLab shipped an out-of-band critical security patch (19.5.1) for a severe, remotely reachable regex-compiler integer overflow vulnerability, prompting discussion about the root cause and a possible shared class of bugs.

items.title: Compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI Installs a Credential Stealer and Backdoor
items.title_zh: PyPI 上的 LiteLLM 1.107.0 被投毒，内置凭据窃取器与后门
items.title_en: Compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI Shipped Credential Stealer and Backdoor
items.summary: A compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 release on PyPI shipped a credential stealer and backdoor, prompting discussion of recurring supply chain attacks and developer key hygiene.

items.title: Eight Bits of Trust: eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
items.title_zh: eMudhra 中间证书密钥熵仅 8 位，毫秒级即被破解
items.title_en: eMudhra CA used 8-bit RSA keys, cracked in milliseconds
items.summary: A major certificate authority issued certificates with trivially factorable RSA keys, exposed by Google's paranoid_crypto tool, highlighting systemic weaknesses in the CA trust model and the difficulty of remediating unpatachable devices.

items.title: Meta ordered to pay $25B penalty in New Mexico Cambridge Analytica case
items.title_zh: 新墨西哥州剑桥分析案裁定Meta赔偿250亿美元
items.title_en: Meta ordered to pay New Mexico $25B in Cambridge Analytica case
items.summary: New Mexico secured a historic $25B penalty against Meta over Cambridge Analytica-related consumer protection violations, prompting discussion of appeals, settlement comparisons, and executive accountability.

items.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
items.title_zh: OpenAI 模型将进驻 Google Cloud 模型花园
items.title_en: OpenAI Models Are Coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden
items.summary: OpenAI models are being made available through Google Cloud, a notable cross-competitor partnership that lets GCP customers apply cloud spend commitments to OpenAI inference.

items.title: The Huawei-DeepSeek Symbiosis
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis深度解析华为昇腾950PR与DeepSeek的软硬协同
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis dissects Huawei Ascend 950PR and DeepSeek's chip symbiosis
items.summary: A detailed SemiAnalysis report on Huawei Ascend 950PR benchmarks, DeepSeek model analysis, and DeepSeek's support for Ascend hardware.

items.title: Uber 用 AI 自动清理技术债，已删逾 16000 个过期 feature flag
items.title_zh: Uber 的 AutoClean AI 代理已从生产代码中删除逾 16000 个过期功能开关
items.title_en: Uber's AutoClean AI agents have deleted 16,000+ stale feature flags from production code
items.summary: Uber's AutoClean system uses AI agents plus deterministic rewriting and a multi-agent review gate to automatically remove stale feature flags from production monorepos, having deleted over 16,000 flags and a million-plus lines of code.
